FAITHFUL PORT, not a redesign — visual/behavioral parity with product-website/reference/index.html in both themes and at breakpoints 900/860/700/480/420. Reuse the app's design-token NAMES exactly (tokens.css from the reference :root + dark blocks; do not fork/rename the palette; site-only --map/--map-road/--map-road-2 stay). -> set:html for HTML-bearing keys only). Parity check cs<->en key sets. TypeScript strict; Node >=20. This folder is OUTSIDE web/ — web/'s eslint/vitest/size gates do NOT apply; the site's gate is npm run build + astro check + the parity check + visual/a11y verification.
